column1: # rowkeyraft's own build lines, which scripts/check.sh allows for a consumer on
# v0.9.0 or later: every option line of .bazelrc after the import of the
# shared options, every override, patch and declaration of a shared module
# in MODULE.bazel, and every copts, features and defines of a BUILD file.
# Each entry is a kind (bazelrc, module or build), the line as check.sh
# prints it, and the reason the consumer needs it, separated by tabs. A
# line is added here before the consumer adds it, and removed after.
